posts.title: South Austin (78704) Spring 2026 Recap
posts.summary: Prices cooled slightly as inventory rose. A balanced-market snapshot for SoCo buyers and sellers.
posts.bodyHtml:
South Austin's spring told a different story than the frenzied pandemic-era market. Inventory rose meaningfully and the median sale price eased 1.8% year over year to $742,500 — welcome news for buyers who've been priced out of 78704.

A more balanced market

With homes taking about a month to sell, sellers need to price realistically and present well. Buyers finally have negotiating room and the luxury of a second showing before writing an offer.

This is the healthiest South Austin has felt for buyers in years. If you've been waiting, it's worth a fresh look at what your budget covers today.
